project.name: Scalable Brain
project.subtitle: Multi-System Algorithmic Trading Architecture
project.thesis: The code is not the asset. A verified out-of-sample track record is the asset.

principles.title: Preservation over profit
principles.technical: When a risk rule and a profit opportunity conflict, the rule wins. No override path exists in code.
principles.plain: Not losing the money matters more than making it. If a safety rule says no, nothing can talk it into yes.

principles.title: No downstream recomputation
principles.technical: System 3 never re-scores a signal. System 2 never re-sizes an order. System 1 never knows whether it is live.
principles.plain: Each part does its own job once, and trusts the part before it. Nobody second-guesses anybody, so there is exactly one place to look when something is wrong.

principles.title: Default-safe posture
principles.technical: Missing data, stale input or an internal error resolves to REJECT, never APPROVE. If System 3 is unreachable, System 2 pauses.
principles.plain: When in doubt, do nothing. Silence is treated as a no, never as a yes.

principles.title: Deterministic, idempotent, auditable
principles.technical: The same signal, regime and model artifact must produce an identical decision. Replays are no-ops. Every decision is logged with full context.
principles.plain: Run it twice, get the same answer twice. Everything that happened is written down and can be replayed later.
